changelog:
- Added "handwritten marker" (马克笔) style as a core visual feature for main text and accents, emphasizing thick, uneven marker strokes and a natural hand-drawn effect.
- Updated description, templates, and text style guidance to require bold handwritten marker text (not sans-serif) for all Chinese content.
- Adjusted sample compositions and color references to reflect the new marker style.
- Clarified prompt templates and output rules to enforce the marker handwriting requirement throughout the poster design process.
